sections.open.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities anyone can find and join.

sections.invited.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the communities only invited people can open.

sections.solo.label.description: Section heading in the list of the person's communities, on the Communities screen and in the Your communities switcher: the projects that have no member but this person.

sections.open.noun.description: What one community anyone can find and join is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.invited.noun.description: What one community only invited people can open is called, as a singular noun naming its audience.

sections.solo.noun.description: What a project with no member but this person is called, naming its audience. It stands where "Public community" or "Private community" would.

sections.open.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.open.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Public communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.invited.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Private communities section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's communities are in that section.

sections.solo.count_one.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.solo.count_other.description: Accessible name of the number beside the Just you section heading. {{count}} is how many of the person's projects have no other member. "Just you" is the section's name.

sections.shownOf_one.description: Number beside a section heading in the list of the person's communities, while the section is folded: how many of its communities are listed out of how many it has, as in "3 of 27". {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOf_other.description: Number beside a section heading in the list of the person's communities, while the section is folded: how many of its communities are listed out of how many it has, as in "3 of 27". {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOfLabel_one.description: Accessible name of the "3 of 27" number beside a folded section heading in the list of the person's communities. The heading's own name says which section. {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.shownOfLabel_other.description: Accessible name of the "3 of 27" number beside a folded section heading in the list of the person's communities. The heading's own name says which section. {{shown}} is how many rows show, {{count}} the section's total.

sections.showFewer.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities, once every community in it is showing: folds the section back to its first few rows.

sections.showMore_one.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

sections.showMore_other.description: Last row of a section in the list of the person's communities: reveals the next communities in that section. {{count}} is how many this press reveals.

filter.label.description: Accessible name of the row of filter chips above the list of every community the person is in (All, Public, Private, Just you) on the All communities page.

filter.all.description: Filter chip above the list of the person's communities: shows every community they are in, whoever it is for.

filter.open.description: Filter chip above the list of the person's communities: shows only the public communities (anyone can see and join them).

filter.invited.description: Filter chip above the list of the person's communities: shows only the private communities (people are invited in).

filter.solo.description: Filter chip above the list of the person's communities: shows only the projects nobody else is in yet.

filter.allCount_one.description: Accessible name of the All filter chip above the list of the person's communities, with how many communities they are in. {{count}} is that number.

filter.allCount_other.description: Accessible name of the All filter chip above the list of the person's communities, with how many communities they are in. {{count}} is that number.

list.loading.description: Accessible name of the placeholder rows on the Communities screen while the person's list of communities is loading.

list.loadError.description: Title of the error card on the Communities screen when the list of the person's communities could not be loaded. A retry button follows it.

list.empty.title.description: Title of the card on the Communities screen when the person belongs to no community. The card is a link to Discover.

list.empty.subtitle.text: Browse the directory to find a project to join.
list.empty.subtitle.description: Second line of the card on the Communities screen when the person belongs to no community. The directory is the Discover screen; a project is what a community builds.

list.join.title.description: Row under the list on the Communities screen: opens Discover, where the person can find a community to join.

list.join.subtitle.text: Find one to join in Discover.
list.join.subtitle.description: Second line of the Join a community row on the Communities screen. "One" is a community; Discover is the name of the screen and of its tab.

list.start.title.description: Row under the list on the Communities screen: opens the dialog that creates a new project and its community.

list.start.subtitle.text: Make a project for you, a group or everyone.
list.start.subtitle.description: Second line of the Start a community row on the Communities screen. The three audiences a new project can be made for: only this person, an invited group, or the public.

row.members_one.description: Quiet fact on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many people belong to that community.

row.members_other.description: Quiet fact on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many people belong to that community.

row.inviteOut.description: Quiet fact on a project's row on the Communities screen, in place of when it was last active: the person has sent an invite link for it and nobody has joined yet.

row.active.justNow.description: The whole quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: it was last active less than a minute ago. Drawn in its own element, in lower case.

row.active.minutes_one.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many minutes ago it was last active. "m" abbreviates minutes; keep it short.

row.active.minutes_other.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many minutes ago it was last active. "m" abbreviates minutes; keep it short.

row.active.hours_one.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many hours ago it was last active. "h" abbreviates hours; keep it short.

row.active.hours_other.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many hours ago it was last active. "h" abbreviates hours; keep it short.

row.active.days_one.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many days ago it was last active. "d" abbreviates days; keep it short.

row.active.days_other.description: Quiet fact on the row of a project that is just the person's own, on the Communities screen: how many days ago it was last active. "d" abbreviates days; keep it short.

row.inProgress_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many changes people are working on in its project right now.

row.inProgress_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many changes people are working on in its project right now.

row.toVote_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

row.toVote_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen: how many proposals and group decisions in it are waiting for this person's vote. "To vote" means still to be voted on by you.

row.newMessages_one.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen, after how many proposals wait for the person's vote ("1 to vote · 1 new message"): how many messages in its chat channel the person has not read yet.

row.newMessages_other.description: Status on a community's row on the Communities screen, after how many proposals wait for the person's vote ("1 to vote · 5 new messages"): how many messages in its chat channel the person has not read yet.

needsYou.heading.description: Section heading at the top of the Communities screen, over the row that opens the feed of votes waiting for this person across all their projects.

needsYou.waiting_one.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: how many votes across the person's projects they have not yet seen or cast.

needsYou.waiting_other.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: how many votes across the person's projects they have not yet seen or cast.

needsYou.skipped_one.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen when nothing new waits: how many votes the person looked at and passed over without voting, which they can still cast.

needsYou.skipped_other.description: Title of the Needs you row on the Communities screen when nothing new waits: how many votes the person looked at and passed over without voting, which they can still cast.

needsYou.projectsMore_one.description: Second line of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: which projects the votes are owed on. {{projects}} is the first three project names, already joined as a list; {{count}} is how many further projects there are.

needsYou.projectsMore_other.description: Second line of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: which projects the votes are owed on. {{projects}} is the first three project names, already joined as a list; {{count}} is how many further projects there are.

needsYou.review.description: Verb, at the end of the Needs you row on the Communities screen: says that pressing the row opens the votes waiting for the person so they can go through them.

needsYou.back.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the back arrow over the Needs you feed on the Communities screen: returns to the list of the person's communities. Communities is the screen's name.

needsYou.over.description: Small line above the title of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen: names the screen the feed belongs to.

needsYou.title.description: Title of the page of the Communities screen that shows, one at a time, every vote waiting for this person across their projects.

reel.fallbackTitle.change.description: Stands in for the title of a proposal (a change to a project put up for a vote) in the Needs you feed when the proposal has no title.

reel.fallbackTitle.decision.description: Stands in for the title of a group decision (a vote on a project's settings, such as a rename, rather than on a code change) in the Needs you feed when it has no title.

reel.ask.change.description: Question over the Yes and No buttons of a proposal in the Needs you feed: asks whether the proposed change should be merged into the project.

reel.ask.decision.description: Question over a group decision in the Needs you feed: asks whether the decision (for example a rename of the project) should be carried out.

reel.yes.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes for the change going in.

reel.no.description: Vote button on a proposal in the Needs you feed of the Communities screen: votes against the change going in.

reel.error.text: Couldn't load what is waiting on you. Each project's own Needs you page still has it.
reel.error.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when it could not be loaded. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page, which lists the same votes for that project.

reel.loading.description: Accessible name of the empty placeholder shown while the Needs you feed on the Communities screen is loading.

reel.empty.text: Nothing is waiting on your vote in any of your projects.
reel.empty.description: Shown in place of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when no proposal or group decision is waiting for this person's vote.

reel.done.description: Button on the card at the end of the Needs you feed on the Communities screen: returns to the list of the person's communities.

reel.capped_one.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_one.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

reel.capped_other.text: Showing the newest {{count}}. Each project's own Needs you page has the rest.
reel.capped_other.description: Note under the Needs you feed on the Communities screen when there are more votes than it loads. {{count}} is how many it shows. Needs you is also the name of a tab on every project's page.

switcher.title.description: Title of the switcher that lists every community the person belongs to, opened from the header's name or the Communities tab, for moving from one community to another.

switcher.all.name.description: First row of the Your communities switcher: leaves the single community being shown and opens the list of all of the person's communities.

switcher.all.count_one.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.count_other.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher: how many communities the person belongs to.

switcher.all.every.description: Second line of the All communities row in the Your communities switcher while the list is still loading, so there is no count to show yet.

switcher.loading.description: Note in the Your communities switcher while the list of the person's communities is loading.

switcher.row.solo.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a project that has no member but this person.

switcher.row.invited_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.invited_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community only invited people can open. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_one.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.row.open_other.description: Second line of a row in the Your communities switcher, for a community anyone can find and join. {{count}} is how many people belong to it. Keep the middle dot between the two facts.

switcher.toVote_one.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.toVote_other.description: Badge on a row of the Your communities switcher: how many proposals and group decisions in that community (or, on the All communities row, in all of them) are waiting for this person's vote.

switcher.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search field at the top of the Your communities switcher, which filters the person's communities by name as they type.

switcher.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the Your communities switcher. It can also be reached with Command+K or Ctrl+K.

switcher.search.results.description: Accessible name of the list of communities whose names match what the person typed in the Your communities switcher's search.

switcher.search.none.description: Shown in the Your communities switcher when no community the person is in has the searched words in its name. {{query}} is what they typed.

switcher.recent.description: Small heading in the Your communities switcher over the communities the person used most recently (and the ones they pinned), above the All communities row.

switcher.join.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens Discover, where the person can find a community to join.

switcher.start.description: Row at the end of the Your communities switcher: closes it and opens the dialog that creates a new project and its community.

drawer.outer.name.description: On a phone, under the Communities tab: the name, for a screen reader, of the outermost level of the navigation drawer, the list of every community the person is in.

drawer.places.name.description: On a phone, under the Communities tab: the name, for a screen reader, of the drawer level that lists one community's places (Hub, Needs you, Workshop, its channels). {{community}} is the community's name.

drawer.peek.page.description: On a phone, under the Communities tab: what a screen reader says for the edge of the page that peeks in beside a community's places; pressing it slides back to that page. {{page}} is the page's name, for example Workshop or #general.

drawer.search.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search field at the top of the list of the person's communities, in the phone's navigation drawer.

drawer.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of the list of the person's communities, in the phone's navigation drawer.

drawer.search.cancel.description: Button beside the communities search in the phone's navigation drawer: ends the search, clears it, and narrows the list back so the community's places peek in again.

drawer.search.none.description: Shown in the phone's navigation drawer when no community the person is in has the searched words in its name. {{query}} is what they typed.

review.end.line.description: Quiet line at the end of the new Needs you feed (an experiment), under a check mark, once every waiting change has been shown.

review.page.back.description: Accessible name of the back button in the header of a change's page in the new Needs you flow (an experiment).

review.page.more.description: Accessible name of the ⋯ button in the header of a change's page in the new Needs you flow (an experiment). Opens Open the change page and Copy link.

review.thumbs.label.description: Accessible name of the row of small screen pictures under a change's before and after slider in the new Needs you flow (an experiment).

review.thumbs.one.description: Accessible name of one small screen picture under a change's slider in the new Needs you flow (an experiment). {{n}} is its position, {{total}} how many there are.

review.alt.after.description: Alt text of the after picture in a change's before and after slider (new Needs you flow, an experiment).

review.alt.before.description: Alt text of the before picture in a change's before and after slider (new Needs you flow, an experiment).

review.compare.label.description: Accessible name of the before and after slider on a change's page (new Needs you flow, an experiment). Drag sideways, or use the arrow keys, to compare.

review.compare.showingAfter.text: Showing the screen after the change
review.compare.showingAfter.description: Screen reader value of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen after the change.

review.compare.showingBefore.text: Showing the screen before the change
review.compare.showingBefore.description: Screen reader value of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen before the change.

review.compare.after.description: Word on the small pill at the top of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen after the change. Keep it to one short word.

review.compare.before.description: Word on the small pill at the top of the before and after slider when most of it shows the screen before the change. Keep it to one short word.

review.compare.pillAfter.text: Showing after. Tap to see before
review.compare.pillAfter.description: Accessible name of the pill on the before and after slider while it shows the after screen: tapping it shows the before screen, holding it peeks.

review.compare.pillBefore.text: Showing before. Tap to see after
review.compare.pillBefore.description: Accessible name of the pill on the before and after slider while it shows the before screen: tapping it shows the after screen, holding it peeks.

review.sheet.label.description: Accessible name of the vote sheet at the foot of a change's page (new Needs you flow, an experiment).

review.sheet.more.description: Accessible name of the small handle at the top of the vote sheet while it rests: tapping it opens the help (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it, About).

review.sheet.close.description: Accessible name of the small handle at the top of the vote sheet while it is open: tapping it folds the sheet back.

review.sheet.backToHelp.description: Accessible name of the back button beside a help page's title in the vote sheet (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it, About).

review.vote.yes.description: Button in the vote sheet on a change's page: vote for the change going live.

review.vote.no.description: Button in the vote sheet on a change's page: vote against the change. It asks for one line on what would make it a yes.

review.vote.approve.description: Yes button in the vote sheet on a change to a project that is just yours, where your yes is the one it needs.

review.vote.dontApprove.description: No button in the vote sheet on a change to a project that is just yours.

review.unsure.open.description: Quiet button under Yes and No in the vote sheet: opens the ways to look closer before voting.

review.unsure.line.text: Your vote counts once. If most members say yes, it goes live for everyone.
review.unsure.line.description: Short line in the vote sheet's help, under Yes and No, saying how a change is decided.

review.unsure.label.description: Accessible name of the list of help rows in the vote sheet (Ask privately, Discussion, Try it, About).

review.unsure.ask.title.description: Help row in the vote sheet, and the title of its page: ask questions about the change that only you see.

review.unsure.ask.line.description: Second line of the Ask privately help row in the vote sheet.

review.unsure.talk.title.description: Help row in the vote sheet, and the title of its page: the change's conversation.

review.unsure.talk.line.description: Second line of the Discussion help row in the vote sheet.

review.unsure.try.title.description: Help row in the vote sheet, and the title of its page: open a live copy with this change.

review.unsure.try.line.text: A live copy with this change
review.unsure.try.line.description: Second line of the Try it help row in the vote sheet, when the change has a live preview.

review.unsure.try.none.description: Second line of the Try it help row in the vote sheet, when the change has no live preview at the moment.

review.unsure.about.title.description: Help row in the vote sheet, and the title of its page: what the change does, who made it, and how deciding works.

review.unsure.about.line.text: What it does, who made it
review.unsure.about.line.description: Second line of the About this change help row in the vote sheet.

review.no.ask.text: What would make it a yes?
review.no.ask.description: Question over the line a person writes when they vote No in the vote sheet. The line is optional; it goes to the person who made the change.

review.no.placeholder.description: Placeholder in the box for a No vote's line, which is optional. {{name}} is the username of the person who made the change.

review.no.placeholderNoName.text: One line for whoever made it
review.no.placeholderNoName.description: Placeholder in the box for a No vote's line, when the change's maker is not known.

review.no.left_one.description: Small line under a No vote's box when it is nearly full.

review.no.left_other.description: Small line under a No vote's box when it is nearly full.

review.no.cancel.description: Button that leaves the No vote's line without voting.

review.no.send.description: Button that casts the No vote, with its line if one is written.

review.said.yes.description: Title in the vote sheet after voting Yes, under a large check mark.

review.said.no.description: Title in the vote sheet after voting No, under a large mark.

review.said.undo.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting: takes the vote back while voting is still open.

review.said.next.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting: moves sideways to the next change waiting on you.

review.said.done.description: Button in the vote sheet after voting on the last change without your vote: opens the all-done message, which says that nothing else is waiting and offers the way back to the list.

review.alldone.line.description: Heading of the vote sheet in the new Needs you flow (an experiment), under a check, after Done on the last change waiting on your vote. Same words as the end of the Needs you list.

review.ask.note.text: Only you see this. Answers come from the change itself.
review.ask.note.description: Line at the top of Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.who.description: Name over an answer in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.q1.description: Suggested question in Ask privately in the vote sheet. Tapping it asks it.

review.ask.q2.description: Suggested question in Ask privately in the vote sheet. Tapping it asks it.

review.ask.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the question box in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.send.description: Button that sends a question in Ask privately in the vote sheet.

review.ask.reading.description: Placeholder answer in Ask privately while the answer is on its way.

review.ask.failed.text: Couldn't get an answer just now. Try again in a moment.
review.ask.failed.description: Answer in Ask privately when the question could not be answered and the server gave no reason.

review.ask.offline.text: You seem to be offline. Try again when you're connected.
review.ask.offline.description: Answer in Ask privately when the question could not be sent.

review.try.note.text: A live copy with this change. Nothing you do there is kept.
review.try.note.description: Line on the Try it page of the vote sheet, over the button that opens the live copy.

review.try.open.description: Button on the Try it page of the vote sheet: opens the change's live preview.

review.try.none.text: There's no live copy of this change right now. Its page may be able to start one.
review.try.none.description: Line on the Try it page of the vote sheet when the change has no live preview.

review.about.what.description: Small heading on the About this change page of the vote sheet, over the change's summary.

review.about.who.description: Small heading on the About this change page of the vote sheet, over who made it and where.

review.about.builtBy.description: Row on the About this change page. {{name}} is the username of the person who made the change.

review.about.inApp.description: Row on the About this change page: the project the change is for. {{app}} is its name.

review.about.number.description: Small line under the project row on the About this change page. {{number}} is the change's number.

review.about.deciding.description: Small heading on the About this change page of the vote sheet.

review.about.decidingLine.text: Each member votes once and can change their vote while voting is open. If most say yes, the change goes live for everyone.
review.about.decidingLine.description: Paragraph on the About this change page explaining how a change is decided.

review.more.open.description: Menu entry and link: opens the change's full page with everything about it.

review.more.copy.description: Menu entry that copies a link to the change's page.

review.more.copied.description: Menu entry's words just after the link to the change's page was copied.

review.more.cancel.description: Menu entry that closes the ⋯ menu on a change's page.

review.benefit.fixed.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.stability.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.clarity.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.more.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.results.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.speed.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.effort.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.security.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.benefit.behind.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): the benefit a change brings, for a change with no screenshots. Shown in small capitals beside the part of Homeroom it touches.

review.area.agents.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.proposals.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.platform.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.projects.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.accounts.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.admin.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.messages.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.area.challenges.description: Label over a drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment), after the benefit: the part of Homeroom the change is felt in.

review.decision.closeIssue.description: Label over a group decision's drawn picture in the new Needs you (an experiment): what kind of decision it is. Shown in small capitals beside the project's name.
